misprints.note: The article is printed without its circumflex.
The headword is printed with ä, but the same entry uses fånga elsewhere. Kept as printed.

uncertain.note: The accent on the relative is unclear: it could be ὅ or ὃ. I kept ὅ.
The mark over the a is small and could be a ring or dots. I read å (Råegg) to match the run of Rå- headwords.
The genitive ending looks like a bare acute (ός) with no breathing.
The å in the headword is blotted. Read as Råsten from the alphabetical order.
